sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Prior instructions remain valid. Repair the applicability and evidence logic: bind the required calculation case to the linked localFrameSectionCalculationCase/member relationship rather than using an unbound ?calculationCase that searches globally. The current local-frame SPARQL also checks only interpolation endpoints, omits the required plasticNeutralAxisHeight result, and its NOT EXISTS condition can produce accidental passes or failures. Encode the area-exceeds condition and 20<framingAngleOmega<70 branch against the linked member and plating, and require the linked calculation case to contain both interpolation endpoints with their coordinate/result values and the conditional plasticNeutralAxisHeight evidence when applicable.
